candidate_identity: candidate-files.sha256 (final content identity; no commit created)
scope: CI attempt observation; release paths inspected, unchanged; no distribution acceptance claim
authority: User delivery contract sections 2, 3, 6; repository AGENTS.md and existing workflows
adopted_gate: Collector rejects incomplete/malformed attempt/job sets; never certifies release acceptance

objective.delivery: Provisional future objective: >=10% lower median creation-to-last-required-job completion on equivalent warm CI inputs; <=5% runner-second increase, no cold regression >10%, no lost coverage. Not evaluated in instrumentation iteration.
objective.iteration: Capture all eight sampled runs and all attempts including non-success; reproducible job/step durations; unknown release boundaries remain null.

population.selection: latest eight runs, unfiltered by outcome, captured once before candidate
population.window: Snapshot in /tmp/b4-ci-runs.json; raw selected metadata retained in evidence.json

cases: malformed time / duplicate job / incomplete page
unchanged_release_channels: Mac prod signed/notarized ZIP plus stable-name asset and tap PR
iOS prod/beta upload via owner script
hub linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 OCI index, GHCR semver tags, ECS production, Helm OCI chart

runners.image_versions: actual historical runner image/tool versions unknown without logs; labels retained per job

environment: No secret values collected; event/head_sha/path/attempt/labels retained; flags per unchanged workflows

caches.SwiftPM: existing .build and dependency downloads; OS+lock key; broad OS restore
caches.state: unknown per sampled run; no shared cache operations

cost_limits.dollars: unknown; no additional hosted compute authorized or used

rollback: Remove collector/tests and CI test step; revert evidence docs. No database, artifact, cache or channel state changed.
holdout: Synthetic failed attempt followed by partial rerun with skipped native job; reserved until implementation frozen
pipeline_policy: No speed optimization without equivalent run evidence; instrumentation is reported separately
